expected_behavior: Lists standard benefits then premium tier perks

turns.user_message: What are the benefits of the rewards program?
turns.agent_response:
The Momentum program allows you to earn points and Tier Credits through slots, table games, poker, dining, and hotel stays. These points are redeemable for free play, meals, hotel stays, and retail purchases throughout the resort.

The program consists of five tiers: Core, Ignite (2,500 credits), Leap (10,000 credits), Ascend (25,000 credits), and Soar (invitation only). Higher tiers unlock specific benefits such as priority restaurant seating, complimentary valet, and room upgrades, though these are subject to availability and status. You can track your progress or join for free at any Momentum Desk on the casino floor or via the Mohegan Sun mobile app.

A useful detail for new members is that your points are valid at most of the retail shops in the concourse, not just for gaming or dining. I'd love to show you how those benefits apply to your stay—may I ask your name so I can look up the best offers for you?

The Ascend tier is reached at 25,000 Tier Credits and includes complimentary valet, room upgrades based on availability, and access to a dedicated host. The Soar tier is the highest level and is available by invitation only, providing personalized service and exclusive access to events. At these levels, you also have access to high-limit gaming areas for table games and slots which feature elevated minimum bets and premium drink service.

An insider tip: Ascend and Soar members often receive priority for hotel check-in and check-out, which is particularly useful during peak weekend hours. Based on your tier status and play history, you may be eligible for dining credits at restaurants like Tuscany or SolToro, which open up as you progress through the levels. You can confirm your current credit balance and eligibility for these perks at any Momentum Desk.

Since you are interested in the higher-tier benefits, do you prefer playing table games or slots during your visit?
